ops.message_vi: Tạo model mới 'Hợp đồng' (hop_dong) với 3 trường, RLS theo tenant + quyền ['manager']

sql.sql:
CREATE TABLE "xt_data"."hop_dong" (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT xt.tenant(),
  owner_id uuid DEFAULT xt.actor(),
  team_id uuid,
  department_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
  created_by uuid,
  updated_by uuid,
  revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "so_hd" text NOT NULL,
  "khach_hang" uuid NOT NULL,
  "gia_tri" bigint,
  CONSTRAINT "pk_m3" PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT "uq_m3_tid" UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
)
CREATE INDEX "ix_m3_owner" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" (tenant_id, owner_id)
CREATE INDEX "ix_m3_created" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" (tenant_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX "ix_m3_dept" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" (tenant_id, department_id)
CREATE INDEX "ix_m3_team" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" (tenant_id, team_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ux_m3_f1" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" (tenant_id, "so_hd")
ALTER TABLE "xt_data"."hop_dong" ADD CONSTRAINT "fk_m3_f2" FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, "khach_hang") REFERENCES "xt_data"."khach_hang" (tenant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CREATE INDEX "ixr_m3_f2" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" (tenant_id, "khach_hang")
CREATE TRIGGER xt_touch BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION xt.row_touch()
CREATE TRIGGER xt_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION xt_audit.log()
ALTER TABLE "xt_data"."hop_dong" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE "xt_data"."hop_dong" FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" TO "xt_app"
CREATE POLICY "p_m3_tenant" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" AS RESTRICTIVE FOR ALL TO "xt_app" USING (tenant_id = xt.tenant()) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = xt.tenant())
CREATE POLICY "p_m3_read" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO "xt_app" USING ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true))
CREATE POLICY "p_m3_create" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO "xt_app" WITH CHECK ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true))
CREATE POLICY "p_m3_update" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO "xt_app" USING ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true)) WITH CHECK ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true))
CREATE POLICY "p_m3_delete" ON "xt_data"."hop_dong" AS PERMISSIVE FOR DELETE TO "xt_app" USING ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true))
COMMENT ON TABLE "xt_data"."hop_dong" IS 'Hợp đồng'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "xt_data"."hop_dong"."so_hd" IS 'Số hợp đồng'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "xt_data"."hop_dong"."khach_hang" IS 'Khách hàng'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "xt_data"."hop_dong"."gia_tri" IS 'Giá trị'

ops.message_vi: MỞ RỘNG quyền trên 'Khách hàng': sales:create own→team, sales:read own→team, sales:update own→team

sql.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "p_m1_tenant" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang"
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "p_m1_read" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang"
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "p_m1_create" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang"
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "p_m1_update" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang"
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "p_m1_delete" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang"
CREATE POLICY "p_m1_tenant" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang" AS RESTRICTIVE FOR ALL TO "xt_app" USING (tenant_id = xt.tenant()) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = xt.tenant())

CREATE POLICY "p_m1_read" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO "xt_app" USING ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true) OR (xt.has_role('sales') AND (owner_id = xt.actor() OR xt.in_teams(team_id))))

CREATE POLICY "p_m1_create" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO "xt_app" WITH CHECK ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true) OR (xt.has_role('sales') AND (owner_id = xt.actor() OR xt.in_teams(team_id))))

CREATE POLICY "p_m1_update" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO "xt_app" USING ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true) OR (xt.has_role('sales') AND (owner_id = xt.actor() OR xt.in_teams(team_id)))) WITH CHECK ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true) OR (xt.has_role('sales') AND (owner_id = xt.actor() OR xt.in_teams(team_id))))
CREATE POLICY "p_m1_delete" ON "xt_data"."khach_hang" AS PERMISSIVE FOR DELETE TO "xt_app" USING ((xt.has_role('manager') AND true))
